question: Why is right knowledge said to be the sole cause of liberation?
premises: Right knowledge is the sole cause of liberation.
The divisions of self, other, and so on are mere conceptual constructions.
These divisions appear as abiding in self and other.
inference: Liberation depends on right knowledge because the apparent divisions it overcomes are only conceptual.
plain_english: Right knowledge is the sole cause of liberation, because the manifestations of self, other, and so on are nothing more than conceptual construction.
